summary.en: A comprehensive TypeScript utility library standardizing CLI, input, filesystem, HTTP, package and text helpers.
summary.pt: Uma biblioteca abrangente de utilitários TypeScript que padroniza helpers de CLI, input, filesystem, HTTP, pacotes e texto.

description.en:
The Decaf Utils module is a comprehensive TypeScript utility library designed to standardize APIs across repositories and provide a robust foundation for command-line applications. It is organized into CLI (abstract Command class, option handling and standardized execution flow), Input (interactive prompts, validation and command-line argument parsing), Utils (filesystem, package management, HTTP downloads, text processing and environment handling), Writers (OutputWriter, StandardOutputWriter, RegexpOutputWriter) and Output (formatting and banners). It is the light version of the Decaf CLI.

### Capabilities

- **Abstract Command class** — Implement custom CLI commands with standardized input handling, logging and execution flow.
- **Interactive input** — UserInput prompts for text, number and confirmation values with validation and defaults.
- **Filesystem operations** — Read, write, copy and delete files and directories with safe helpers.
- **HTTP and package helpers** — Download files from URLs and retrieve package information, dependencies and versions.
- **Text processing** — String interpolation, case conversion (camelCase, snake_case) and regular-expression utilities.
- **Output writers** — OutputWriter contract plus StandardOutputWriter and RegexpOutputWriter implementations.
description.pt:
O módulo Decaf Utils é uma biblioteca abrangente de utilitários TypeScript criada para padronizar APIs entre repositórios e oferecer uma base robusta para aplicações de linha de comando. Organiza-se em CLI (classe abstrata Command, opções e fluxo de execução padronizado), Input (prompts interativos, validação e parsing de argumentos), Utils (filesystem, gerenciamento de pacotes, downloads HTTP, processamento de texto e variáveis de ambiente), Writers (OutputWriter, StandardOutputWriter, RegexpOutputWriter) e Output (formatação e banners). É a versão leve do Decaf CLI.

### Capabilities

- **Classe abstrata Command** — Implemente comandos CLI customizados com tratamento de entrada, logging e fluxo de execução padronizados.
- **Entrada interativa** — Prompts UserInput para texto, número e confirmação com validação e valores padrão.
- **Operações de filesystem** — Leia, escreva, copie e apague arquivos e diretórios com helpers seguros.
- **Helpers de HTTP e pacotes** — Baixe arquivos de URLs e obtenha informações de pacotes, dependências e versões.
- **Processamento de texto** — Interpolação de strings, conversão de caixa (camelCase, snake_case) e utilitários de expressões regulares.
- **Writers de saída** — Contrato OutputWriter com implementações StandardOutputWriter e RegexpOutputWriter.

summary.en: A fast MiniLogger core with pluggable adapters, filters and transports for browser and Node.js.
summary.pt: Um núcleo MiniLogger rápido com adaptadores, filtros e transports plugáveis para navegador e Node.js.

description.en:
Decaf logging keeps one fast MiniLogger at the core while exposing adapters, filters and utilities that fit both browser and Node.js runtimes. Configure once through Logging.setConfig (or the Environment accumulator) and let impersonated child loggers inherit overrides without extra allocations. Filter chains, transports and adapter-specific features (Pino, Winston, custom factories) share a single LoggingConfig contract, while decorators, LoggedClass and Logging.because instrument classes. StopWatch, text/time utilities and environment helpers round out the diagnostics surface.

### Capabilities

- **MiniLogger core** — A small, dependency-light context-aware logger used by default across decaf packages.
- **Global configuration** — Configure once via Logging.setConfig or the Environment accumulator; child loggers inherit overrides.
- **Filters and transports** — Pluggable filter chains and transports, including sensitive-data filtering.
- **Adapter integrations** — Ships Pino and Winston adapters plus custom LoggerFactory support without changing call sites.
- **Decorators and benchmarking** — @log and @benchmark instrument methods; StopWatch and text/time helpers aid diagnostics.
description.pt:
O logging da Decaf mantém um MiniLogger rápido no núcleo e expõe adaptadores, filtros e utilitários que funcionam em navegador e Node.js. Configure uma vez com Logging.setConfig (ou o acumulador Environment) e deixe que loggers filhos impersonados herdem as configurações sem alocações extras. Cadeias de filtros, transports e recursos específicos de adaptador (Pino, Winston, fábricas customizadas) compartilham um único contrato LoggingConfig, enquanto decoradores, LoggedClass e Logging.because instrumentam as classes. StopWatch, utilitários de texto/tempo e helpers de ambiente completam a superfície de diagnóstico.

### Capabilities

- **Núcleo MiniLogger** — Um logger pequeno e leve, ciente de contexto, usado por padrão nos pacotes decaf.
- **Configuração global** — Configure uma vez via Logging.setConfig ou o acumulador Environment; loggers filhos herdam as configurações.
- **Filtros e transports** — Cadeias de filtros e transports plugáveis, incluindo filtragem de dados sensíveis.
- **Integrações de adaptador** — Fornece adaptadores Pino e Winston e suporte a LoggerFactory customizado sem alterar os pontos de uso.
- **Decoradores e benchmarking** — A @log e @benchmark instrumentam métodos; StopWatch e helpers de texto/tempo auxiliam no diagnóstico.

summary.en: The testing toolkit for Decaf packages: evidence reporting, jest helpers, performance runs and Xray teardowns.
summary.pt: O kit de testes para pacotes Decaf: relatórios de evidências, helpers jest, execuções de performance e teardowns Xray.

description.en:
@decaf-ts/for-testing is the testing toolkit for Decaf packages, packaging the evidence and reporting pipeline that used to live under @decaf-ts/utils/tests into its own repository so runtime packages no longer carry test-only code. The backend toolkit is the default export: TestReporter collects test evidence (messages, objects, tables, attachments) into a report storage directory, and ConsumerRunner orchestrates consumer/producer comparison across forked processes. Jest helpers (itReportsOnFailure, ReportExpect) report failures and evidence directly from tests, JestPerformanceRunner runs performance scenarios and reports phase tables and charts, and runJestXrayTeardown/runJestAgileTestTeardown convert JUnit reports and evidence into Xray and AgileTest payloads. UI helpers are grouped under the ui namespace. The published GitHub Pages site is not yet live, so the docs link points to the repository README.

### Capabilities

- **TestReporter** — Collects messages, objects, tables and attachments into a report directory.
- **ConsumerRunner** — Forks a producer, collects logs and compares consumer/producer interleaving.
- **Jest helpers** — itReportsOnFailure and ReportExpect report failures and evidence from tests.
- **Performance runner** — JestPerformanceRunner reports phase tables and charts.
- **Xray and AgileTest** — Teardowns convert JUnit reports into Xray/AgileTest import payloads.
- **UI namespace** — A stable ui surface for future browser and component helpers.

summary.en: Flavour-aware decorator builder and a centralized runtime metadata store for TypeScript classes and their members.
summary.pt: Construtor de decoradores sensível a flavours e um armazenamento centralizado de metadados em runtime para classes TypeScript e seus membros.

description.en:
The decoration module provides two complementary capabilities: a small builder-style API (Decoration) to define and apply decorators that can vary by flavour, and a centralized runtime Metadata store for structured information about classes and their members. Decorations are registered under a key (for example for("component")), with a default "decaf" flavour that can be overridden or extended by framework-specific flavours (vue, nest, angular). A global flavour resolver decides which decorators apply to a given target, and the resulting decorator function encodes the flavour and key for easier debugging.

### Capabilities

- **Flavour-aware decorators** — Define a base decorator and override or extend it per framework/environment without changing call sites.
- **Centralized Metadata store** — Read and write nested metadata keys (properties.name, description.class) for classes and members.
- **Utility decorators** — @metadata, @prop, @method, @param and @apply compose and record metadata declaratively.
- **reflect-metadata integration** — Captures Reflect design:type hints for properties and mirrors metadata on the constructor.
- **Debug-friendly** — Generated decorators encode the flavour and key in their function name.
description.pt:
O módulo decoration fornece duas capacidades complementares: uma API em estilo builder (Decoration) para definir e aplicar decoradores que podem variar por flavour, e um armazenamento centralizado de metadados (Metadata) para informações estruturadas de classes e seus membros. Os decoradores são registrados sob uma chave (por exemplo for("component")), com um flavour padrão "decaf" que pode ser sobrescrito ou estendido por flavours específicos de framework (vue, nest, angular). Um resolvedor global de flavour decide quais decoradores se aplicam a um alvo, e a função de decorador resultante codifica o flavour e a chave para facilitar a depuração.

### Capabilities

- **Decoradores sensíveis a flavour** — Defina um decorador base e sobrescreva-o ou estenda-o por framework/ambiente sem alterar os pontos de uso.
- **Armazenamento centralizado de Metadata** — Leia e escreva chaves de metadados aninhadas (properties.name, description.class) para classes e membros.
- **Decoradores utilitários** — A @metadata, @prop, @method, @param e @apply compõem e registram metadados de forma declarativa.
- **Integração com reflect-metadata** — Captura dicas de Reflect design:type para propriedades e espelha metadados no construtor.
- **Fácil de depurar** — Os decoradores gerados codificam o flavour e a chave no nome da função.

summary.en: Declarative, decorator-driven validation, model building, serialization and hashing for TypeScript.
summary.pt: Validação declarativa por decoradores, construção de modelos, serialização e hashing para TypeScript.

description.en:
Decorator Validation is a TypeScript library with two complementary pillars: declarative validation via decorators and a model system tailored for validation, building, hashing and serialization. Property decorators such as @required, @min, @max, @minLength, @maxLength, @pattern, @email, @url, @type, @equals, @greaterThan and @list write strongly-typed metadata under a common keying convention, backed by concrete Validator classes. Models are ordinary classes marked with @model(); class-level decorators (@hashedBy, @serializedBy, @description) configure algorithms, and the Model base class adds a registry, validation, comparison, hashing and serialization. Validation is exposed as a pluggable IValidatorRegistry and can optionally be published as MCP tools.

### Capabilities

- **Rich validation decorators** — @required, @min/@max, @minLength/@maxLength, @pattern, @email, @url, @type, @equals, @list and date validators.
- **Model base class** — Validation, serialization, hashing and comparison methods plus a model registry for rebuild flows.
- **Pluggable validator registry** — Register, migrate and query custom Validator implementations through Validation.
- **Serialization and hashing strategies** — @serializedBy and @hashedBy configure pluggable serializers and hash algorithms.
- **MCP tool exposure** — Optionally expose validation as MCP tools for automation workflows.

summary.en: A lightweight, decorator-based dependency-injection registry with lazy loading and custom transformations.
summary.pt: Um registro leve de injeção de dependências baseado em decoradores, com carregamento preguiçoso e transformações customizadas.

description.en:
injectable-decorators is a standalone, lightweight dependency-injection system for TypeScript applications. A central Injectables registry manages injectable objects, caches singleton instances and provides registration, retrieval and building. @injectable() marks a class as available for injection (with optional category naming for minification safety and post-creation callbacks), while @inject() injects a dependency into a property, resolving its type from TypeScript reflection and supporting custom transformers. Dependencies are lazy-loaded only when accessed, and specific injectables can be selectively reset by name pattern.

### Capabilities

- **@injectable() classes** — Register a class as an injectable singleton retrievable from the registry.
- **@inject() properties** — Inject a registered dependency into a property, resolving its type automatically.
- **Lazy loading** — Dependencies are only instantiated when accessed, simplifying injection order.
- **Singleton or on-demand** — Choose shared singletons or a fresh instance per injection.
- **Custom transformations** — Transform an injected instance before it reaches the target object.
- **Selective reset** — Reset specific injectables in the registry by name pattern.
description.pt:
injectable-decorators é um sistema de injeção de dependências leve e autônomo para aplicações TypeScript. Um registro central Injectables gerencia objetos injetáveis, armazena instâncias singleton e fornece registro, recuperação e construção. @injectable() marca uma classe como disponível para injeção (com nome de categoria opcional para segurança em minificação e callbacks pós-criação), enquanto @inject() injeta uma dependência em uma propriedade, resolvendo seu tipo por reflexão TypeScript e suportando transformadores customizados. As dependências são carregadas preguiçosamente apenas quando acessadas, e injetáveis específicos podem ser redefinidos seletivamente por padrão de nome.

### Capabilities

- **Classes @injectable()** — Registre uma classe como singleton injetável recuperável do registro.
- **Propriedades @inject()** — Injete uma dependência registrada em uma propriedade, resolvendo seu tipo automaticamente.
- **Carregamento preguiçoso** — As dependências só são instanciadas quando acessadas, simplificando a ordem de injeção.
- **Singleton ou sob demanda** — Escolha singletons compartilhados ou uma nova instância por injeção.
- **Transformações customizadas** — Transforme uma instância injetada antes de ela chegar ao objeto alvo.
- **Reset seletivo** — Redefina injetáveis específicos no registro por padrão de nome.

description.en:

summary.en: Decorators and utilities for the repository pattern: model identity, composition, versioning and operation hooks.
summary.pt: Decoradores e utilitários para o padrão repositório: identidade de modelo, composição, versionamento e hooks de operação.

description.en:
db-decorators is a TypeScript framework for database operations that leverages decorators to simplify persistence. It implements the repository pattern with model definition, validation, identity management and operation hooks. An abstract BaseRepository provides the CRUD foundation and a concrete Repository adds validation, with bulk operations through BulkCrudOperator. Models use @id() for identity, @composed()/@composedFromKeys() for composition, @version() for versioning and @transient() for non-persisted properties. Pre-operation hooks (@on, @onCreate, @onUpdate) and post-operation hooks (@after, @afterCreate, @afterUpdate) attach custom logic through the Operations registry, and a hierarchical Context carries state through the layers.

### Capabilities

- **Repository pattern** — Abstract BaseRepository plus a validating Repository and BulkCrudOperator bulk support.
- **Identity and composition** — @id(), @composed() and @composedFromKeys() define identity and composed properties.
- **Operation hooks** — Pre-hooks (@on, @onCreate, @onUpdate) and post-hooks (@after, @afterCreate).
- **Versioning and transient** — @version() and @transient() manage optimistic concurrency and non-persisted fields.
- **Context management** — Hierarchical context chains with parent-child relationships and accumulation.
- **Validation integration** — Automatic validation during CRUD through decorator-validation.
description.pt:
db-decorators é um framework TypeScript para operações de banco de dados que usa decoradores para simplificar a persistência. Implementa o padrão repositório com definição de modelos, validação, gerenciamento de identidade e hooks de operação. Uma BaseRepository abstrata fornece a base de CRUD e uma Repository concreta adiciona validação, com operações em lote via BulkCrudOperator. Modelos usam @id() para identidade, @composed()/@composedFromKeys() para composição, @version() para versionamento e @transient() para propriedades não persistidas. Hooks de pré-operação (@on, @onCreate, @onUpdate) e pós-operação (@after, @afterCreate, @afterUpdate) anexam lógica customizada pelo registro Operations, e um Context hierárquico carrega estado entre as camadas.

### Capabilities

- **Padrão repositório** — BaseRepository abstrata, Repository com validação e suporte a operações em lote via BulkCrudOperator.
- **Identidade e composição** — @id(), @composed() e @composedFromKeys() definem identidade e propriedades compostas.
- **Hooks de operação** — Pré-hooks (@on, @onCreate, @onUpdate) e pós-hooks (@after, @afterCreate).
- **Versionamento e transientes** — @version() e @transient() gerenciam concorrência otimista e campos não persistidos.
- **Gerenciamento de contexto** — Cadeias de contexto hierárquicas com relações pai-filho e acumulação.
- **Integração com validação** — Validação automática durante o CRUD via decorator-validation.

summary.en: Transaction management through decorators and locks, with atomic execution and concurrency control.
summary.pt: Gerenciamento de transações por decoradores e locks, com execução atômica e controle de concorrência.

description.en:
Transactional Decorators is a standalone module providing transaction management and concurrency control for TypeScript applications. The Transaction class manages the lifecycle (creation, execution, cleanup), binding to objects and methods and propagating transaction context. A flexible lock system controls access to shared resources: Lock is the base class with queuing, TransactionLock defines the contract, and SynchronousLock (SyncronousLock) is the default one-at-a-time implementation; MultiLock allows a configurable number of concurrent transactions. @transactional() wraps a method in a transaction with error handling, and transactionalSuperCall() preserves continuity across inheritance.

### Capabilities

- **@transactional() methods** — Wrap a method in a transaction with creation, binding and error handling.
- **Lock system** — Lock base class with queuing plus a TransactionLock contract.
- **SynchronousLock** — Default one-at-a-time transaction processing in submission order.
- **MultiLock** — Allow a configurable number of concurrent transactions.
- **Instance proxying** — Bind transactions to objects through proxies that keep context across calls.
- **Transaction chaining** — Link transactions to group operations into a single atomic unit.

Um sistema flexível de locks controla o acesso a recursos compartilhados: Lock é a classe base com fila, TransactionLock define o contrato e SynchronousLock é a implementação padrão de um por vez; MultiLock permite um número configurável de transações concorrentes. @transactional() envolve um método em uma transação com tratamento de erros, e transactionalSuperCall() preserva a continuidade na herança.

### Capabilities

- **Métodos @transactional()** — Envolva um método em uma transação com criação, vinculação e tratamento de erros.
- **Sistema de locks** — Classe base Lock com fila e contrato TransactionLock.
- **SynchronousLock** — Processamento padrão de uma transação por vez na ordem de submissão.
- **MultiLock** — Permita um número configurável de transações concorrentes.
- **Proxy de instâncias** — Vincule transações a objetos por meio de proxies que mantêm o contexto entre chamadas.
- **Encadeamento de transações** — Encadeie transações para agrupar operações em uma única unidade atômica.

summary.en: The foundational Decaf package: models, repository pattern, adapters, a query DSL, task engine and migrations.
summary.pt: O pacote base da Decaf: modelos, padrão repositório, adaptadores, DSL de consulta, motor de tarefas e migrações.

description.en:
Decaf Core provides the foundational building blocks for the Decaf TypeScript ecosystem: strongly-typed models, the repository pattern, pluggable persistence adapters, a composable query DSL and pagination/observer utilities. With decorators and an injectable registry it wires models to repositories and adapters so you can build data access that is framework-agnostic yet fully typed. It centers on Repository (CRUD, querying, observation), Adapter (backend contract), Statement/Condition (fluent queries), the Task Engine for background jobs and worker threads, ModelService/PersistenceService base classes, a migration system and an in-memory RAM adapter. High-level repository queries such as find, findBy, findOneBy, listBy, countOf and aggregate helpers (maxOf, minOf, avgOf, sumOf, distinctOf, groupOf, existsOf) cover common access patterns.

### Capabilities

- **Repository pattern** — Repository<M> with CRUD, bulk operations, querying and observers.
- **Pluggable adapters** — Adapter abstraction with an in-memory RAM adapter plus HTTP, TypeORM, CouchDB, Pouch, Nano and Drizzle backends.
- **Query DSL** — Fluent Statement/Condition building with pagination and ordering.
- **Task engine** — Define, schedule and execute background jobs with worker threads and composite-step concurrency.
- **Services and migrations** — ModelService/PersistenceService base classes plus a migration system for schema changes.
- **Advanced queries** — find, findBy, listBy, countOf, pagination and aggregate helpers (maxOf, sumOf, distinctOf).
description.pt:
O Decaf Core fornece os blocos de construção fundamentais para o ecossistema TypeScript da Decaf: modelos fortemente tipados, o padrão repositório, adaptadores de persistência plugáveis, uma DSL de consulta componível e utilitários de paginação/observação. Com decoradores e um registro injetável, conecta modelos a repositórios e adaptadores para construir acesso a dados agnóstico de framework, porém totalmente tipado. Baseia-se em Repository (CRUD, consultas, observação), Adapter (contrato de backend), Statement/Condition (consultas fluentes), no Task Engine para jobs em segundo plano e worker threads, nas classes base ModelService/PersistenceService, em um sistema de migrações e no adaptador em memória RAM. Consultas de alto nível como find, findBy, findOneBy, listBy, countOf e agregadores (maxOf, minOf, avgOf, sumOf, distinctOf, groupOf, existsOf) cobrem padrões comuns de acesso.

### Capabilities

- **Padrão repositório** — Repository<M> com CRUD, operações em lote, consultas e observadores.
- **Adaptadores plugáveis** — Abstração Adapter com adaptador em memória RAM e backends HTTP, TypeORM, CouchDB, Pouch, Nano e Drizzle.
- **DSL de consulta** — Construção fluente de Statement/Condition com paginação e ordenação.
- **Motor de tarefas** — Defina, agende e execute jobs em segundo plano com worker threads e concorrência de etapas compostas.
- **Serviços e migrações** — Classes base ModelService/PersistenceService e um sistema de migrações para mudanças de schema.
- **Consultas avançadas** — find, findBy, listBy, countOf, paginação e agregadores (maxOf, sumOf, distinctOf).

summary.en: A unified SubtleCrypto interface for browser and Node.js, with model property encryption and JWT support.
summary.pt: Uma interface SubtleCrypto unificada para navegador e Node.js, com criptografia de propriedades de modelo e suporte a JWT.

description.en:
The @decaf-ts/crypto module offers a suite of cryptographic utilities designed to integrate seamlessly within the Decaf ecosystem. It provides a unified SubtleCrypto interface for both browser and Node.js environments, simplifying secure data handling. A powerful @encrypt decorator automatically encrypts and decrypts model properties during database operations, while robust tools cover JSON Web Token (JWT) signing and verification. It wraps Crypto and SubtleCrypto in a browser-resilient way and integrates optionally with the Decaf framework for secure model data and authentication tokens.

### Capabilities

- **@encrypt decorator** — Automatically encrypt and decrypt decorated model properties during persistence.
- **Unified SubtleCrypto** — One API for browser and Node.js cryptographic operations.
- **JWT sign and verify** — Create and verify JSON Web Tokens for authentication flows.
- **Browser resilient** — Wraps Crypto/SubtleCrypto with fallbacks that work in both runtimes.
- **Decaf integration** — Optional integration with the Decaf model and repository layers.
description.pt:

Um poderoso decorador @encrypt criptografa e descriptografa automaticamente propriedades de modelos durante operações de banco de dados, enquanto ferramentas robustas cobrem assinatura e verificação de JSON Web Token (JWT). Ele envolve Crypto e SubtleCrypto de forma resiliente a navegador e integra opcionalmente com o framework Decaf para dados de modelo sensíveis e tokens de autenticação.

### Capabilities

- **Decorador @encrypt** — Criptografe e descriptografe automaticamente propriedades decoradas de modelos durante a persistência.
- **SubtleCrypto unificado** — Uma API para operações criptográficas em navegador e Node.js.
- **Assinar e verificar JWT** — Crie e verifique JSON Web Tokens para fluxos de autenticação.
- **Resiliente a navegador** — Envolve Crypto/SubtleCrypto com fallbacks que funcionam em ambos os runtimes.
- **Integração com a Decaf** — Integração opcional com as camadas de modelo e repositório da Decaf.

summary.en: CRUD-style repositories and services over REST APIs, with an Axios adapter and a webhook engine.
summary.pt: Repositórios e serviços no estilo CRUD sobre APIs REST, com adaptador Axios e motor de webhooks.

description.en:
for-http is a lightweight HTTP adapter layer for Decaf that enables CRUD-style repositories and services over REST APIs. It defines a generic HttpAdapter with a ready-to-use Axios implementation, a RestService for simple model-centric operations and a RestRepository when repository decoration logic is needed before submitting to the backend. HttpConfig provides minimal protocol/host configuration and HttpFlags adds request-scoped headers. The package also ships a persistent webhook engine with a @hook decorator, topic matching, signature verification and retry strategy, and integrates with the NestJS integration module.

### Capabilities

- **Generic HttpAdapter** — Maps create/read/update/delete and bulk variants onto REST endpoints.
- **AxiosHttpAdapter** — Ready-to-use adapter built on Axios with URL building and error parsing.
- **RestService and RestRepository** — Model-centric service by default, or a repository when lifecycle logic matters.
- **Headers via flags/context** — Pass request-scoped headers through HttpFlags and the context.
- **Webhook engine** — Persistent subscriptions, @hook topics, signature verification and retries.
- **Auth handler contract** — Pluggable AuthHandler for request auth extraction and authorization.
description.pt:
for-http é uma camada de adaptador HTTP leve para a Decaf que permite repositórios e serviços no estilo CRUD sobre APIs REST. Define um HttpAdapter genérico com implementação Axios pronta para uso, um RestService para operações simples centradas em modelo e um RestRepository quando é necessária lógica de decoração antes de enviar ao backend. HttpConfig fornece configuração mínima de protocolo/host e HttpFlags adiciona cabeçalhos por requisição. O pacote também traz um motor de webhooks persistente com o decorador @hook, correspondência de tópicos, verificação de assinatura e estratégia de retry, além de integrar com o módulo NestJS.

summary.en: A declarative approach to UI rendering: render models as components with validation and CRUD-aware visibility.
summary.pt: Uma abordagem declarativa de renderização de UI: renderize modelos como componentes com validação e visibilidade por operação CRUD.

description.en:
ui-decorators extends decorator-validation and db-decorators with a declarative approach to UI rendering. Models become renderable UI components, with an abstract RenderingEngine that can be implemented for different frameworks (Angular, React, HTML5, React Native). Class decorators @uimodel(tag, props), @renderedBy(engine) and @uilistmodel(tag, props) describe how a model renders and how it appears in lists, while property decorators @uiprop, @uielement, @uilistprop, @hideOn and @hidden map properties to components and control visibility per CRUD operation. The engine translates model types to input types, applies validation to elements and supports list rendering with item templates.

### Capabilities

- **@uimodel and @renderedBy** — Mark a model as renderable, pick its HTML tag and choose a rendering engine.
- **Property mapping** — @uiprop, @uielement and @uilistprop map model properties to component properties.
- **Visibility control** — @hideOn(...operations) and @hidden() control per-operation field visibility.
- **List rendering** — @uilistmodel plus item templates render collections of models.
- **Pluggable rendering engines** — Abstract RenderingEngine with type translation and validation integration.

A engine traduz tipos de modelo para tipos de input, aplica validação aos elementos e suporta renderização de listas com templates de item.

summary.en: A modular CLI framework that discovers and loads commands from any Decaf package through a single decaf entry point.
summary.pt: Um framework CLI modular que descobre e carrega comandos de qualquer pacote Decaf por um único ponto de entrada decaf.

description.en:
The Decaf CLI is a powerful and extensible command-line interface framework that provides a unified entry point for all Decaf modules. CliWrapper discovers, loads and executes CLI modules, crawling the filesystem to find cli-module files, importing them and registering commands with Commander.js. CLIUtils normalizes ESM/CommonJS imports and retrieves package information, and each module exports a function returning a Commander Command. Commands follow the pattern decaf <module> <command> [options], so new functionality can be added without modifying the core CLI.

### Capabilities

- **Dynamic discovery** — Recursively crawls the project and dependencies to find cli-module files.
- **Unified decaf entry point** — All module commands are reachable through a single decaf command.
- **CliWrapper** — Discovers, imports and registers CLI modules with Commander.js.
- **CLIUtils** — Normalizes ESM/CommonJS imports and retrieves package name and version.
- **Modular architecture** — Each package defines its own commands independently and is self-documenting.

Os comandos seguem o padrão decaf <module> <command> [options], de modo que novas funcionalidades podem ser adicionadas sem modificar o núcleo da CLI.

description.en:
The Decaf CouchDB module is a persistence layer integrating Decaf with CouchDB. CouchDBAdapter handles CRUD, sequence management and error handling, and can be extended for custom needs. The query system provides CouchDBStatement for type-safe Mango queries, CouchDBPaginator for bookmark-based pagination and operator translation from Decaf core to Mango. Indexing tools generate index configurations from model metadata, CouchDBSequence implements sequential IDs, and specialised error types translate CouchDB error codes. Utilities cover authentication, connection management and document processing.

### Capabilities

- **CouchDBAdapter** — CRUD, sequences and error handling, extensible for custom needs.
- **Mango query system** — CouchDBStatement with type-safe Mango queries and operator translation.
- **Bookmark pagination** — CouchDBPaginator paginates results using CouchDB bookmarks.
- **Index management** — Generates and maintains index configurations from model metadata.
- **Sequences** — CouchDBSequence and a sequence model for sequential IDs.
- **Error translation** — Maps CouchDB error codes and messages to Decaf error types.

Utilitários cobrem autenticação, gerenciamento de conexão e processamento de documentos.

description.en:
for-nano integrates CouchDB via the Nano client into the Decaf data stack. NanoAdapter bridges Decaf Repository operations with Nano DocumentScope: repository-friendly CRUD and bulk variants, transparent revision metadata via PersistenceKeys.METADATA/CouchDBKeys.REV, raw Mango queries, index management and connection/admin helpers (connect, createDatabase, deleteDatabase, createUser, deleteUser). NanoDispatch subscribes to the continuous changes feed, groups frames by table and operation and notifies observers, with reconnection handling. NanoRepository is a typed alias binding Repository to MangoQuery, NanoAdapter and NanoFlags, which carry a user object for consistent auth context.

### Capabilities

- **NanoAdapter** — CRUD and bulk operations over Nano DocumentScope.
- **Transparent revisions** — Manages CouchDB _rev through internal metadata without leaking into models.
- **Raw Mango and indexes** — raw() executes Mango queries and index() manages indexes.
- **Change feed dispatch** — NanoDispatch observes the continuous changes feed with reconnection.
- **Admin helpers** — createDatabase, deleteDatabase, createUser and deleteUser.

O NanoDispatch assina o change feed contínuo, agrupa frames por tabela e operação e notifica observadores, com tratamento de reconexão. O NanoRepository é um alias tipado que vincula Repository a MangoQuery, NanoAdapter e NanoFlags, que carregam um objeto de usuário para contexto de autenticação consistente.

- **NanoAdapter** — CRUD e operações em lote sobre o DocumentScope do Nano.

description.en:
for-pouch integrates PouchDB with the Decaf data and decorator ecosystem. It provides a concrete PouchAdapter persisting against a local or remote CouchDB-compatible backend, a typed PouchRepository alias for Repository and Mango queries, and configuration/flag types tailored to PouchDB. A module entry wires flavour-specific createdBy/updatedBy decorations when loaded. It targets the PouchDB 9.x plugin line (pouchdb-core, pouchdb-find, adapters, mapreduce, replication); WebSQL is not a direct dependency. CRUD and bulk operations, Mango queries, sorting with defined indexes, pagination, multiple databases via alias and seamless model decoration are all supported.

### Capabilities

- **PouchAdapter** — Concrete persistence against local or remote CouchDB-compatible storage.
- **PouchRepository** — Typed Repository alias for Mango queries and pagination.
- **CRUD and bulk ops** — Single and bulk operations with proper error mapping.
- **Multiple databases** — Support for multiple databases and aliases.
- **Model decoration** — createdBy/updatedBy metadata and relation handling.
- **PouchDB 9.x plugin line** — Built on pouchdb-core, pouchdb-find, mapreduce and replication.

description.en:
for TypeORM provides a complete implementation of Decaf data-access abstractions backed by a TypeORM DataSource, keeping a consistent API across adapters. TypeORMAdapter encapsulates connection management, CRUD/bulk operations, schema helpers, index generation, raw SQL and error translation. TypeORMRepository exposes typed CRUD and batch operations with validation, and TypeORMStatement/TypeORMPaginator convert Decaf statements into TypeORM find options and QueryBuilder calls with pagination. Decorator overrides mirror TypeORM decorators (Entity, Column, PrimaryColumn, JoinColumn, OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToOne) so compatible metadata is emitted, and TypeORMSequence plus generateIndexes handle sequences and SQL index statements.

### Capabilities

- **TypeORMAdapter** — Connection management, CRUD/bulk ops, raw SQL, schema and index helpers.
- **TypeORMRepository** — Typed CRUD with validation, context/flags and observers.
- **Statement and paginator** — Translates Decaf statements to TypeORM options/builders with pagination.
- **Decorator wiring** — Mirrors TypeORM decorators automatically on import.
- **Transactions** — @transactional backed by real Postgres transactions.
- **Sequences and indexes** — TypeORMSequence and generateIndexes for IDs and SQL indexes.

O TypeORMRepository expõe CRUD tipado e operações em lote com validação, e TypeORMStatement/TypeORMPaginator convertem statements Decaf em find options do TypeORM e chamadas ao QueryBuilder com paginação. Overrides de decoradores espelham os decoradores do TypeORM (Entity, Column, PrimaryColumn, JoinColumn, OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToOne) para emitir metadados compatíveis, e TypeORMSequence e generateIndexes cuidam de sequências e statements de índice SQL.

description.en:
for-fabric provides chaincode-side building blocks for Hyperledger Fabric written in TypeScript, adapting Decaf Repository/Model/Adapter abstractions to Fabric world state. FabricContractAdapter implements CRUD, bulk operations, raw Mango queries, result iteration, model preparation/reversion, composite-key prefixes and sequence creation, bridging Decaf to ChaincodeStub and ClientIdentity. FabricContractRepository supports create/update, bulk ops, read/readAll, raw queries, select projections and event emission through an ObservableHandler, with a CRUD contract and a serialized JSON contract. @mirror() routes mirrored reads and writes with an optional allow(context) gate, and FabricContractDBSequence plus ContractLogger round out sequences and context-aware logging.

### Capabilities

- **Chaincode contracts** — FabricCrudContract, SerializedCrudContract and an ERC20 sample contract.
- **FabricContractAdapter** — CRUD, raw Mango queries, composite keys and sequences over the world state.
- **Repository and events** — FabricContractRepository emits first-class Fabric events from operations.
- **Mirrored data** — @mirror() routes mirrored reads/writes with an optional allow(context) gate.
- **Sequences and logging** — FabricContractDBSequence and ContractLogger bound to the contract context.
- **Client-side usage** — Connects to a network, listens for events and works with identities.

description.en:
for-nest integrates Decaf with NestJS. DecafModule.forRootAsync(options) bootstraps persistence wiring, controller exposure and the request pipeline, while DecafAuthModule.forRoot(options) (or manual wiring) adds authentication. Auth decorators @Auth(model), @Public, @RequireRoles, @RequireNamespaces and @SkipFabricIdentity guard handlers, backed by an AuthHandler<EC, C, D> and namespace authorization with AuthData/UserData. The auth interceptor resolves context and authorization, DecafWebhookModule.forRootAsync(options) delivers persistent webhooks, and the migration execution pipeline runs schema migrations. Note that the repository workdocs still use the template README, so this page is sourced from the module source and its How-to-Use guide.

### Capabilities

- **DecafModule.forRootAsync** — Bootstrap Decaf persistence, controllers and the request pipeline.

description.en:
@decaf-ts/integrations centralizes reusable helpers for Keycloak, Kibana, Nest-style auth and org-based authorization scaffolding. It exposes subpath entrypoints for graph, nest/graph, keycloak, kibana, nest, namespaces, loader and plugins (including Kibana and Superset). The graph engine, backend node catalogue and run lifecycle execute canonical GraphWorkflowDocuments through a nine-stage validation gate that resolves every node kind against a trusted backend catalogue, rejects inline client definitions and unsafe prototype keys, and separates parameters/credentials/metadata from inputs. Other modules cover namespace authorization, dynamic object loading and Keycloak/Kibana provisioning. The repository has no published workdocs page, so this page is sourced from the module README and source.

### Capabilities

- **Keycloak provisioning** — Realm, client and user provisioning helpers.
- **Kibana provisioning** — Data views, dashboards, roles and users.
- **Nest auth** — Nest-style auth integration with Decaf request contexts.
- **Namespaces authorization** — Tenant, org-unit, role, permission and resource scaffolding.
- **Graph engine** — Canonical GraphWorkflowDocument execution with a nine-stage validation gate.
- **Loader and plugins** — Dynamic object loading plus Kibana and Superset plugins.
description.pt:

Expõe subpaths para graph, nest/graph, keycloak, kibana, nest, namespaces, loader e plugins (incluindo Kibana e Superset). O motor de graph, o catálogo de nós do backend e o ciclo de vida de execução executam GraphWorkflowDocuments canônicos por meio de um gate de validação de nove estágios que resolve cada tipo de nó contra um catálogo confiável do backend, rejeita definições inline do cliente e chaves de protótipo inseguras, e separa parameters/credentials/metadata de inputs. Outros módulos cobrem autorização por namespace, carregamento dinâmico de objetos e provisionamento Keycloak/Kibana. O repositório não tem página de workdocs publicada, então esta página é baseada no README e no código-fonte.

summary.en: A schema-first Drizzle ORM adapter for SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL.
summary.pt: Um adaptador Drizzle ORM schema-first para SQLite, MySQL e PostgreSQL.

description.en:
for-drizzle plugs Decaf models, repositories and query primitives into SQL databases through Drizzle ORM, keeping the same Repository-first API used across Decaf adapters. DrizzleAdapter handles connection and index() DDL management, CRUD/bulk operations, raw SQL, sequences, transaction locks and error translation; DrizzleRepository is the typed binding for Repository.forModel; DrizzleStatement/DrizzlePaginator translate Decaf statements and conditions into Drizzle SQL. Because Drizzle is schema-first with no decorator entity layer, Decaf decoration (@table, @column, @pk, @index, @unique, relations) is translated into dialect-specific Drizzle tables at runtime; validation stays on the Decaf side. DrizzleMigrator runs the programmatic migrator and generates per-model DDL, and DrizzleDispatch/DrizzleContextLock provide change/observer plumbing and transaction coordination.

### Capabilities

- **DrizzleAdapter** — Connection, index() DDL, CRUD/bulk ops, raw SQL, sequences and transaction locks.
- **DrizzleRepository** — Typed binding for Repository.forModel once the module is imported.
- **Statement and paginator** — Translates Decaf statements/conditions into Drizzle SQL with pagination.
- **Schema translation** — Translates Decaf decoration into Drizzle tables at runtime.
- **SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL** — better-sqlite3, mysql2 and node-postgres drivers.
- **Migrations and dispatch** — DrizzleMigrator per-model DDL plus DrizzleDispatch observers.
description.pt:

Como o Drizzle é schema-first e não tem camada de entidades por decorador, a decoração Decaf (@table, @column, @pk, @index, @unique, relações) é traduzida em tabelas Drizzle específicas do dialeto em runtime; a validação permanece no lado Decaf. O DrizzleMigrator executa o migrator programático e gera DDL por modelo, e DrizzleDispatch/DrizzleContextLock fornecem plumbing de change/observers e coordenação de transações.

summary.en: The decaf-ts AI tooling package: the authoritative skills and agents catalog, plus an MCP server and a decaf CLI module.
summary.pt: O pacote de ferramentas de IA do decaf-ts: o catálogo autoritativo de skills e agentes, além de um servidor MCP e um módulo CLI decaf.

description.en:
`@decaf-ts/with-ai` is the decaf-ts AI tooling package. It ships the canonical catalog of decaf skills and agents under `skills/` and `agents/`, consumed by AI harnesses and by Paperclip orchestration. Its detached Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes Jira, Xray and common tooling; it boots with `decaf with-ai mcp` or the `decaf-mcp` binary, builds clients per tool request, loads credentials lazily so a missing variable never breaks boot, and gates destructive tools behind a server-level policy. The Streamable HTTP transport is bearer-token authenticated and loopback-bound by default. The CLI module also provides `decaf with-ai encrypt-assets` for build-time encryption of AI-value content and `decaf with-ai install-skills` to decrypt and symlink the packaged skills into an AI harness.

### Capabilities

- **Skills & agents catalog** — Canonical markdown skills and agents, consumed by AI harnesses and Paperclip orchestration.
- **MCP server** — A detached Model Context Protocol server exposing Jira, Xray and common tooling over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
- **Lazy credential loading** — The server always boots; a tool whose variables are missing returns a clear error on call instead of failing startup.
- **Destructive-tool policy** — A server-level policy gates destructive tools behind confirm, allow or block.
- **CLI commands** — `decaf with-ai mcp`, `encrypt-assets` and `install-skills` cover boot, packaging and harness setup.

O módulo CLI também oferece `decaf with-ai encrypt-assets` para criptografia de conteúdo de valor de IA em tempo de build e `decaf with-ai install-skills` para descriptografar e criar symlinks das skills empacotadas em um harness de IA.

summary.en: Shared GitHub Actions workflows: build, coverage, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy scans, Renovate remediation and release automation.
summary.pt: Workflows compartilhados do GitHub Actions: build, cobertura, CodeQL, Snyk, varreduras Trivy, remediação Renovate e automação de releases.

description.en:
The `reusable-actions` repository is the workspace scaffold for shared GitHub Actions workflows. It extracts the baseline workflow set used across every decaf-ts repository — CodeQL analysis, Jest coverage, production builds, Pages deployment, publish-on-release, release-on-merge and release-on-tag — into `workflow_call` reusable workflows that a repository consumes as a thin caller pinned to `@master`. It also ships the security remediation pair: `trivy-scan.yml` runs a filesystem vulnerability scan and dispatches a Renovate trigger when findings appear, while `renovate.yml` runs Renovate with a configurable remediation strategy (`overrides`, `bump-dependents` or both) and prunes stale `overrides` once a package is no longer flagged.

### Capabilities

- **Reusable workflows** — Build, coverage, CodeQL, Snyk, Pages and release workflows consumed with `workflow_call`.
- **Trivy vulnerability scan** — `trivy-scan.yml` filters by severity, uploads `trivy-report.json` and dispatches a Renovate trigger.
- **Renovate remediation** — `renovate.yml` applies security updates with `overrides` or `bump-dependents` strategies.
- **Stale override cleanup** — Removes `overrides` whose package is no longer vulnerable in the latest report.
- **Automerge security PRs** — Automerges security PRs once CI is green, scoped by `matchPackageNames`.
description.pt:
O repositório `reusable-actions` é o scaffold de workspace para workflows compartilhados do GitHub Actions. Ele extrai o conjunto base de workflows usado em todos os repositórios decaf-ts — análise CodeQL, cobertura Jest, builds de produção, deploy de Pages, publish-on-release, release-on-merge e release-on-tag — para workflows reutilizáveis `workflow_call` que um repositório consome como caller fino fixado em `@master`. Ele também fornece o par de remediação de segurança: `trivy-scan.yml` executa uma varredura de vulnerabilidades no sistema de arquivos e dispara um gatilho de Renovate quando encontra achados, enquanto `renovate.yml` executa o Renovate com estratégia configurável (`overrides`, `bump-dependents` ou ambas) e remove `overrides` obsoletos quando um pacote deixa de ser sinalizado.

### Capabilities

- **Workflows reutilizáveis** — Workflows de build, cobertura, CodeQL, Snyk, Pages e release consumidos com `workflow_call`.
- **Varredura de vulnerabilidades Trivy** — `trivy-scan.yml` filtra por severidade, envia `trivy-report.json` e dispara um gatilho do Renovate.
- **Remediação com Renovate** — `renovate.yml` aplica atualizações de segurança com estratégias `overrides` ou `bump-dependents`.
- **Limpeza de overrides obsoletos** — Remove `overrides` cujo pacote não é mais vulnerável no relatório mais recente.
- **Automerge de PRs de segurança** — Faz automerge de PRs de segurança quando o CI fica verde, com escopo por `matchPackageNames`.

- **App router scaffold** — layout.tsx and page.tsx wired to Decaf rendering.
- **Model-driven pages** — Pages render from decorated models rather than hardcoded markup.

- **Shared React layer** — for-react-common reused by React-based engines.

It packages Terraform modules and environment variables, Helm charts for the ptp-backend, ptp-frontend, auth, observability and Paperclip services, ArgoCD application manifests, and portable-deployment and security/scalability reviews. It provisions the supporting services an application needs rather than a runtime library. The repository is private and its published workdocs still use the ts-workspace template README, so this page is sourced from the module tree and package metadata; there is no public docs or storyboard page.

- **Terraform modules** — Local and per-environment Terraform configuration.
- **Helm charts** — Charts for ptp-backend, ptp-frontend, auth and observability.
- **ArgoCD** — GitOps application manifests for the platform services.
- **Portable deployments** — Portable-deployment and security/scalability reviews.
